cues.text: A 70-year-old woman has sudden bouts of severe coughing when she is asleep.
Investigations show a pharyngeal pouch. But where exactly does it form?
This muscle is thyropharyngeus, part of the inferior constrictor.
Below it lies cricopharyngeus, the other part of the same muscle.
Between these two parts is a gap called Killian's dehiscence.
A pharyngeal pouch pushes out through this gap.
So the pouch occurs between thyropharyngeus and cricopharyngeus.
